# METADATA.md — Deep Canopy (test fixture)

Publishing language for this channel. Style and boundaries, never copy.

## Title style

Forest-led and seasonal. Vary structure across uploads.

## Description voice

A hushed second-person voice. The forest type, the season if verified, what the viewer hears.

## Keyword usage

Forest, woodland, canopy, the season, the use where true.

## Tags

Six to twelve: forest type, season, region if verified, use.

## Hashtags

Two to four.

## Call to action

One line at most.

## Location naming

Region or forest type; a named forest only when verified.

## Factual claims

No claims about species or age of trees without a source.
